description: Curated retrieval corpus for the WP3 evaluation gate. Each case is a (query, claim) pair across multiple domains; the expected fact is the one ingested from `claim`. `distractors` are extra facts ingested into the same canon so retrieval ranking is non-trivial (the target must out-rank unrelated facts). Designed to be deterministic under the dependency-free hashing embedder.
distractors: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level
The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy in plants
The Great Wall of China was built over many centuries
A leap year has 366 days instead of 365
The human heart has four chambers
Diamond is a crystalline form of carbon
The Amazon is the largest rainforest in the world

cases.query: what temperature does water boil at sea level
cases.claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level

cases.query: how fast does light travel in a vacuum
cases.claim: Light travels at about 299792 kilometres per second in a vacuum

cases.query: what temperature does water freeze at
cases.claim: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius at standard pressure

cases.query: what is the capital of Austria
cases.claim: Vienna is the capital of Austria

cases.query: what is the capital of Japan
cases.claim: Tokyo is the capital of Japan

cases.query: what is the longest river in the world
cases.claim: The Nile is the longest river in the world
The Earth orbits the Sun once per year

cases.query: how many planets are in the solar system
cases.claim: The solar system has eight planets

cases.query: what is the closest star to Earth
cases.claim: The Sun is the closest star to Earth
Gold is a chemical element and a metal

cases.query: what gas do plants absorb from the air
cases.claim: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air

cases.query: what is the chemical symbol for water
cases.claim: The chemical formula for water is H2O

cases.query: what carries oxygen in human blood
cases.claim: Red blood cells carry oxygen in human blood

cases.query: what is the powerhouse of the cell
cases.claim: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell

cases.query: when did the Second World War end
cases.claim: The Second World War ended in 1945

cases.query: what is the value of pi to two decimals
cases.claim: The value of pi is approximately 3.14
